name: EpidBot
description: Chat with EpidBot, the AI assistant for Brazilian public health data (DATASUS/SINAN and 40+ other sources), over the map you are looking at. Answers come back as text, charts and map layers.

assistant.description: Ask EpidBot about Brazilian public health data (DATASUS/SINAN: dengue, COVID-19, vaccination) and add its GeoJSON answers to the map.
